modules.module_title: Set up the sales counter for day's work

pcs.pc_description: prepare and organize the sales counter as per safety norms and organizational standards
place and organize all the tools and equipment at workstation to ensure safety, hygiene and efficiency
ensure cleanliness and availability of adequate space at the display area of the sales counter for displaying food products
display the food and beverage items at the counter to enhance sales
check the food products for clear and accurate labels as per standards
inspect all displayed food products for freshness, cleanliness and visual appeal
ensure that food products are not displayed beyond their expiry date
confirm availability of adequate quantities of food items and other supplies & materials at the workstation as per organizational standards
receive and greet the guest as per organizational policy
present the menu to the guest as per standards
establish guest’s food and beverage requirements quickly
respond to guest’s queries at the counter
suggest food products and beverages to the guests as per their requirement
offer suitable alternatives to the guests for the unavailable items
take orders from guests and process them or pass it on to either QSR coordinator for relaying to kitchen or straight to kitchen either manually or electronically, as required
provide estimated delivery time of the order to the guest
provide instructions to guests regarding the handling, storage and consumption of packed food & beverages, if any
